summary: Baytex Energy Corp. furnished a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer equivalent of a routine current report on Form 8-K) containing its Q3 2026 condensed interim financial statements, MD&A, CEO/CFO certifications and two November 5, 2026 press releases covering quarterly results, an increased 2026 capital plan, 2027 guidance, an accelerated three-year growth outlook and a January 2027 quarterly dividend. No transaction, ownership stake, price per share, premium, advisor recommendation or regulatory clock is disclosed; this is ordinary periodic reporting and a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. Watch solely for capex and production revisions.
